name: Soluble Cutting Oil
equivalent: COOLEDGE - 40, SERVOCUT - S / SHEROL - B / COOL - CUT - 40
tagline: High-performance bio-stable water-soluble cutting fluid for severe metal machining.
description: Kembot Soluble Cutting Oil is a premium emulsifiable metalworking fluid formulated with refined base oils, extreme pressure additives, and multi-component biocides. It forms a highly stable, milky emulsion when mixed with water and provides exceptional cooling and lubricating characteristics.
applications: Recommended for all major metal cutting and machining operations including grinding, planing, drilling, milling, shaping, and turning.
Suitable for both ferrous metals and most non-ferrous alloys.
Ideal for centralized coolant systems as well as individual CNC machines.
usageGuide: General mix ratio is 1:20 for heavy operations and 1:30 for light to medium machining jobs. Compatible with water hardness ranging from 400 to 600 ppm.
features: Superior protection against rust, wear, frictional heat, and bacterial degradation
High biostability preventing rancidity and unpleasant odors during downtime
Excellent surface finish and prolonged tooling life
Low foaming tendency even under high-pressure coolant delivery
Rapid heat dissipation from the cutting zone

name: Straight / Neat Cutting Oil
equivalent: TRIMOFFIN / NORCAM / SERVOCUT / ILOCUT SERIES (51-945)
tagline: Heavy-duty non-emulsifiable straight cutting fluid for precision machining operations.
description: Kembot Neat Cutting Oils (FIN Series) are blended from select solvent-refined mineral oils fortified with fatty oils, extreme-pressure chlor-sulfur compounds, and anti-mist agents to meet demanding machining operations.
applications: Recommended for operations like deep hole drilling, free cutting, broaching, gear hobbing, tapping, and threading.
Suitable for alloy steels, stainless steel, and high-tensile metals.
Note: Sulphurised grades (FIN-SB) are optimized for ferrous alloys and not recommended for active copper/non-ferrous alloys.
usageGuide: Use undiluted directly in dedicated cutting oil reservoirs and flood lubrication setups on automatics, gear shapers, and broaching machines.
features: Maximum boundary lubrication and EP lubricity preventing chip welding
Extended cutting tool durability and razor-sharp edge retention
Superior surface finish with ultra-low tolerances
Anti-mist properties ensuring cleaner workshop air quality
High flash point for maximum workplace safety

name: White Oils (Technical & Pharma Grade)
brand: KEMBOT WHITE - A / KEMBOT WHITE - B
equivalent: Meets All Premium Refined White Oil Specifications
tagline: Highly refined, odorless, tasteless, and chemically inert mineral white oils.
description: Kembot White Oils are severely hydro-treated, ultra-pure paraffinic oils free from aromatic hydrocarbons, sulfur, nitrogen compounds, and heavy metals, offering exceptional color stability and inertness.
applications: Polymer processing, plasticizer in polystyrene, thermoplastic elastomers, and adhesives.
Lubrication of precision textile machinery and food-packaging auxiliary equipment.
Formulation of cosmetics, protective coatings, and industrial specialty chemicals.
usageGuide: Apply directly as a processing oil, batching ingredient, or non-staining lubricant according to technical formulations.
features: Crystal clear water-white appearance (Saybolt color +30)
Completely odorless, tasteless, and non-staining
High UV resistance and thermal stability against discoloration
Chemically inert and hydrophobic moisture barrier

name: Hydraulic Oils (Standard Anti-Wear)
equivalent: SERVO SYSTEM / ENCLO / HYDROL / PERFECT O SERIES
tagline: High-reliability anti-wear and anti-foam hydraulic oils for modern power transmission.
description: Kembot Hydra oils are premium heavy-duty hydraulic power transmission fluids blended with solvent refined base stocks, anti-wear zinc additives, corrosion inhibitors, and foam suppressants.
applications: Hydraulic systems of plastic injection molding machines, presses, machine tools, and construction equipment.
Enclosed industrial gearboxes, vane pumps, piston pumps, and circulating systems.
Industrial air compressors and lightly loaded circulating bearings.
usageGuide: Select the appropriate ISO VG grade (32, 46, 68 for general hydraulics; 100 to 460 for heavy circulating systems and machine gearings) per equipment OEM recommendations.
features: High anti-wear performance preventing pump cavitation and vane scuffing
Excellent demulsibility for fast water separation
Robust anti-foam and air release characteristics
Strong thermal stability reducing sludge and varnish deposits
Full seal compatibility with nitrile, viton, and silicone elastomers

name: Hydraulic Oils HLP Series
spec: IS 11656-1986, DIN 51524 Part 2 (HLP), Cincinnati Milacron P-68/P-69/P-70
equivalent: SERVO SYSTEM HLP / ENCLO HLP / HYDROL HLP SERIES
tagline: High-performance premium HLP hydraulic fluid for high-pressure electro-hydraulic systems.
description: Kembot Hydra HLP oils are advanced premium-performance anti-wear hydraulic oils engineered for severe operating conditions with high pressures, precision servo-valves, and extreme temperature fluctuations.
applications: High-pressure hydrostatic and hydrodynamic hydraulic systems operating above 250 bar.
CNC machine tools, robotics, electro-hydraulic proportional valves, and injection molding machinery.
Mobile hydraulic equipment, excavators, and industrial automation.
usageGuide: Fill directly into clean hydraulic reservoirs. Compatible with standard mineral hydraulic oils; filters down to 3 microns without additive depletion.
features: Meets Cincinnati Milacron P-68, P-69, P-70 and DIN 51524 Part 2 HLP specs
Extreme thermal-oxidative stability for 5000+ operating hours
Rapid air release and anti-cavitation protection
Superior wet filterability preventing valve sticking
Exceptional multi-metal anti-wear protection (copper, bronze, steel)

name: Engine Oils (Linear / Monograde)
equivalent: HYLUBE MILCY / SERVO PRIDE / ACTUMA ULTRA SERIES
tagline: Heavy-duty monograde diesel and gasoline engine oils for commercial vehicles and stationary gensets.
description: Kembot Lube monograde engine oils are formulated with high-viscosity index virgin paraffinic base stocks and detergent-dispersant additive chemistry to protect diesel and petrol engines.
applications: Naturally aspirated and turbocharged heavy-duty diesel engines in trucks, buses, tractors, and construction machinery.
Stationary diesel generator sets, agricultural pump sets, and marine auxiliary engines.
Transmission and hydraulic systems where monograde engine oils are specified by the OEM.
usageGuide: Choose SAE 30 for moderate ambient climates or hydraulic gear uses, SAE 40 for general heavy duty running, and SAE 50 for high ambient temperature applications.
features: Superior wear protection for pistons, liners, cams, and bearings
Exceptional deterrence controlling soot, carbon, and sludge build-up
High thermal stability preventing oil thickening at high operating temperatures
Excellent shear stability maintaining constant lubricating film
Reduced oil consumption and low top-up requirements

name: Industrial Gear Oils & Gear EP Series
equivalent: SERVO GEAR SUPER / SPIROL EP SERIES
tagline: Extreme pressure industrial gear lubricants engineered for heavy shock loads.
description: Kembot Gear EP Series oils are formulated from solvent-extracted high VI base oils combined with sulfur-phosphorus extreme pressure additives that impart exceptional load carrying and anti-scuffing capabilities.
applications: Enclosed spur, helical, bevel, spiral, and planetary industrial gearboxes.
Heavy load applications in steel mills, cement plants, mining crushers, paper machines, and sugar mills.
Plain and antifriction roller bearings subjected to severe shock loads (operating temp up to 90 °C).
usageGuide: Select viscosity grade based on gearbox reduction ratio, operating speed, and temperature. Maintain sump levels per sight glass indicator.
features: Outstanding Extreme-Pressure (EP) protection against micropitting and tooth scuffing
Excellent thermal and oxidation stability preventing sludge formation
Non-corrosive to yellow metals (bronze, brass, copper)
High demulsibility ensuring rapid separation from free water
Superior anti-foam and anti-rust protection

name: Hone Flush Oil & SPL
brand: KEMBOT HONE FLUSH / KEMBOT HONE FLUSH SPL
equivalent: SERVO HONE 7, CASTROL HONILO - 480, 980, 981 SERIES
tagline: Ultra-low viscosity honing fluid with superior flushing action and stone life extension.
description: Kembot Hone Flush is a highly refined low-viscosity specialty oil containing active lubricity enhancers, wetting agents, and anti-weld additives for superfinishing and honing operations.
applications: Honing and superfinishing of engine cylinder liners, bearing races, hydraulic cylinders, and precision tubes.
Machining, turning, drilling, and tapping of aluminum alloys and ferrous metals.
Flushing of swarf and abrasive grit in precision grinding machines.
usageGuide: Use neat via continuous circulation flooding the honing stones and contact zone. Compatible with magnetic swarf separators and cartridge filtration systems.
features: Outstanding flushing power preventing honing stone loading and glazing
Promotes clean, uniform cross-hatch surface finish (low Ra values)
Low odor and ultra-low misting formulation for operator health and safety
High flash point reducing fire risk in high-speed reciprocating heads
Non-staining to sensitive aluminum and yellow metal alloys

name: Spindle Oils (High Speed)
equivalent: SERVO SPIN / HYDROL / SPINTEX SERIES
tagline: Low-viscosity premium oils for high-speed textile and machine tool spindles.
description: Kembot Spin oils are ultra-light viscosity lubricating oils processed from hydrofinished paraffinic base stocks with anti-oxidants, anti-rust, and lubricity film improvers designed for tight-clearance spindle bearings.
applications: High-speed spindles in textile ring spinning, twisting, and winding machines.
Precision grinding machine spindles, CNC engraving heads, and optical tooling.
Positive displacement blowers, timing mechanisms, and low-pressure precision hydraulics.
usageGuide: Fill spindle reservoirs and oil cups. Ensure clean filtration to maintain ultra-smooth spindle rotation up to 30,000+ RPM.
features: Extremely low viscosity minimizing frictional heat and power consumption
Prevents spindle chatter, vibration, and bearing wear at high RPMs
Superior oxidation resistance avoiding gumming and lacquer deposits
Non-staining formulation protecting yarn and fabrics in textile mills
Excellent rust and moisture protection during machine downtime

name: Machinery Oils (General Lubrication)
equivalent: SERVO LINE / CABOL / YANTHROL SERIES J
tagline: All-purpose industrial machinery and line lubrication oils for general manufacturing equipment.
description: Kembot Line oils are economical, high-quality general-purpose machinery lubricating oils formulated with refined straight-run base stocks with good natural lubricity, chemical stability, and film strength.
applications: Textile looms, spinning frames, paper mills, and printing press plain bearings.
Open and semi-enclosed bearing journals, hand-oiled pivots, slides, and linkages.
Air compressors, vacuum pumps, and lightly loaded industrial chain drives.
usageGuide: Apply via drip-feed oilers, manual oil cans, total-loss oiling systems, or continuous centralized lubrication systems.
features: Good film strength providing continuous wear barrier on metal contacts
High natural chemical stability preventing rapid thickening
Protects iron and steel machinery components from atmospheric rust
Economical and versatile across broad multi-machine industrial plants
Wide viscosity spectrum from ISO VG 32 to ISO VG 460

name: Loom Oils (Textile Machinery)
equivalent: SERVO LOOM SERIES
tagline: Special non-drip, scourable lubricant for high-speed textile looms and weaving machinery.
description: Kembot Tex Loom oils are specifically engineered for textile weaving machines with adhesive tackiness additives and scourable surfactants to eliminate oil splashing and allow easy washing if fabric contact occurs.
applications: Lubrication of picking motions, cams, shuttle boxes, harnesses, and crankshaft bearings on textile looms (Sulzer, Dornier, Rapier, Air-jet, and shuttle looms).
Knitting machines, spinning frames, and carding machine sliding parts.
usageGuide: Apply through centralized one-shot lubrication systems or manual oiling cups on weaving looms.
features: Non-drip adhesive polymer prevents oil splatter onto woven fabric
Easily scourable: stains wash off cleanly with conventional textile washing detergents
High load-carrying capacity minimizing wear on picking cams and slide guides
Excellent rust prevention in humid weaving shed environments
Smooth machine operation with reduced vibration and energy drag

name: Quenching Oils (Heat Treatment)
equivalent: SERVO QUENCH / THERMOL / META QUENCH SERIES
tagline: Controlled cooling rate quenching oils for optimum metallurgical hardness and zero cracking.
description: Kembot Quench Series oils are specialized heat treatment fluids formulated from high thermal-stability paraffinic base oils combined with wetting acceleration additives that provide fast, uniform cooling.
applications: Hardening of alloy steel gears, automotive components, crankshafts, and fasteners.
Quenching of high-speed tool steel ball bearings, forging dies, and metal stampings.
Normal and accelerated quenching in open batch baths and continuous furnace tanks.
usageGuide: Maintain bath temperature between 40 °C to 70 °C with proper agitation to avoid localized hot spots and ensure uniform metallurgical grain structure.
features: Fast vapor stage dissipation ensuring uniform martensitic hardening without soft spots
High thermal oxidation stability minimizing sludge accumulation and bath thickening
Low drag-out loss on finished components reducing operational oil consumption
High flash and fire point ensuring maximum safety in commercial heat treatment plants
Delivers clean, bright, stain-free metal components post-quench

name: Thermic Oils (Heat Transfer Fluids)
equivalent: HYTHERM / SERVO THERM / THERMOL SERIES
tagline: High thermal stability heat transfer fluid for closed loop heating systems up to 320 °C.
description: Kembot Therm series oils are severe hydro-cracked mineral heat transfer media with high specific heat and thermal conductivity, delivering trouble-free indirect process heating.
applications: Closed loop, indirect, liquid-phase heat transfer systems in chemical, textile, plywood, food, and pharmaceutical industries.
Jacketed reactors, bitumen heating tanks, drying ovens, and heat exchangers.
usageGuide: Operate with positive nitrogen blanketing on expansion tank for best service life. Maximum bulk oil temp: 300 – 320 °C; maximum film temp: 340 °C.
features: Exceptional resistance to thermal cracking and oxidation prevents carbon deposits on heater tubes
High heat transfer coefficient for optimal energy efficiency and lower fuel costs
Low vapor pressure minimizing system pressure build-up and pump cavitation
Non-corrosive to steel and standard heat transfer pipework
Long operational lifespan with minimal top-up requirements

name: Pneumatic Tool & Rock Drill Oils
equivalent: PNEUMATIC 100, SERVO PNEUM 100, METAMOL R100
tagline: Heavy-duty extreme pressure pneumatic tool lubricants with moisture emulsifying agents.
description: Kembot Pneumo series oils are formulated specifically for air-operated percussive and rotary tools where air expansion causes severe chilling and condensed moisture.
applications: Pneumatic equipment like rock drills, jack hammers, paving breakers, chippers, rivet guns, and air grinders.
Underground mining, tunneling, quarrying, and civil construction air tools.
In-line lubricators and airline mist injection systems.
usageGuide: Fill airline lubricator bottles or inject directly into the tool inlet before operation.
features: Emulsifies compressed air moisture to prevent water wash-off and internal corrosion
Extreme pressure (EP) additives protect reciprocating pistons and rifle bars from seizure
Excellent atomization and misting capability for complete interior component wetting
Tacky adhesive film prevents blow-off under pulsating air blasts
Maintains fluid flow without freezing at low exhaust temperatures

specsTable.label: Emulsion Tendency
specsTable.val: Readily forms protective emulsion with moisture

name: Slideway Oils (Way Lubricants)
equivalent: SERVO WAY / METAMOL / WAYLUBE / MAGNA-BD SERIES
tagline: Anti-stick-slip slideway lubricants for precision CNC and machine tool guide rails.
description: Kembot Way oils are specially developed for the lubrication of horizontal and vertical machine tool slideways, guides, and feed mechanisms to eliminate jerky motion (stick-slip).
applications: Slideways, guideways, and carriages of planers, grinders, horizontal boring machines, shapers, milling machines, and CNC machining centers.
Combined machine tool hydraulic and slideway systems.
Vertical columns and heavy-duty slide tables.
usageGuide: Apply via automated centralized slideway lubrication timers or manual oil dispensers. Compatible with synthetic and water-based cutting coolants.
features: Eliminates stick-slip ensuring micro-positioning accuracy and mirror-like surface finishes
Strong tackiness additives prevent oil run-off from vertical ways
Excellent demulsibility and resistance to washing away by water-soluble cutting coolants
Protects against rust, corrosion, and wear on cast iron and synthetic slideway liners (Turcite)
High film strength withstanding heavy table loads without boundary breakdown

name: Press Oils (Metal Stamping & Drawing)
equivalent: SERVO PRESS SERIES
tagline: Heavy-duty press and deep drawing lubricants providing extreme pressure die protection.
description: Kembot Press series lubricants are formulated with high-film base oils and boundary/EP additives designed for sheet metal pressing, deep drawing, blanking, and punching.
applications: Automotive body panel pressing, appliance stamping, and deep drawing of mild and alloy steels.
Heavy hydraulic press column and mechanical press crank lubrication.
Punching, perforating, and fine-blanking operations.
usageGuide: Apply neat by roller coater, spray nozzles, or drip applicator onto sheet metal blanks prior to entering the press tooling.
features: High lubricity preventing die galling, tearing, and metal pickup
Exceptional film strength under immense multi-ton stamping pressures
Easy degreasing and cleaning with standard alkaline wash baths
Non-staining to sheet metal surfaces with temporary in-process rust protection
Increases die and punch life significantly between regrinding

specsTable.label: Cleaning Compatibility
specsTable.val: Easily removed with warm alkaline wash

name: Glass Cutting Oil
spec: Meets All Premium Glass Industry Standards
equivalent: Meets All Other Reputed Brand Specs (Acecut, Silberschnitt, etc.)
tagline: Specialized low-viscosity cutting fluid for precision flat, float, and automotive glass cutting.
description: Kembot Glass Cutting Oil is a formulated, low-viscosity, controlled-evaporation fluid designed specifically for automated and manual glass scoring and cutting wheels.
applications: Cutting of high-thickness flat glass sheets, float glass lines, and architectural glass.
Automotive windshield and mirror precision scoring.
Automated CNC glass cutting tables and manual hand cutting wheels.
usageGuide: Feed through automatic cutting wheel dispensers or reservoir cutter heads.
features: Binds glass micro-debris and chips preventing surface scratching and tool jamming
Significantly reduces scoring pressure and provides a smooth, defect-free break edge
Controlled volatility: evaporates cleanly leaving no sticky residue before washing
Low odor, non-toxic, and skin-friendly for workshop technicians
Extends cutting wheel carbide service life

name: Transformer Oils (Electrical Insulating)
equivalent: Meets IS-335 Specifications / Reputed Insulating Oils
tagline: Ultra-pure uninhibited dielectric insulating oil for power and distribution transformers.
description: Kembot TF Transformer Oil is a highly refined naphthenic/paraffinic mineral insulating oil possessing superior dielectric properties, high breakdown voltage, and excellent heat dissipation.
applications: Power transformers, distribution transformers, switchgear, and circuit breakers.
Capacitors, tap-changers, and high-voltage electrical bushings.
Industrial substation and grid transformers.
usageGuide: Filter and vacuum dehydrate prior to filling transformers. Test dielectric breakdown voltage (BDV) per IS-335 before commissioning.
features: High dielectric breakdown voltage (BDV > 70 kV post-filtration)
Low dielectric dissipation factor (tan delta) ensuring minimal power loss
Excellent cooling efficiency via rapid convection circulation
Zero corrosive sulfur (ASTM D1275B & DIN 51353 compliant)
High oxidation resistance preventing sludge formation on transformer coils

name: Freeze Oils (Refrigeration Compressor)
equivalent: SERVO FREEZ / FREEZOL SERIES
tagline: Low pour point refrigeration compressor oils for CFC, HCFC, and ammonia chillers.
description: Kembot Freeze oils are specially refined wax-free naphthenic oils designed for the lubrication of refrigeration and air conditioning compressors operating at sub-zero evaporator temperatures.
applications: Industrial refrigeration compressors in cold storage plants, ice factories, and dairies using Ammonia (R717) or Freon refrigerants.
Commercial HVAC chillers, food freezing tunnels, and transport refrigeration.
usageGuide: Ensure strict moisture-free handling. Fill into clean, evacuated refrigeration compressor sumps.
features: Extremely low pour point and wax-free composition preventing flocculation in expansion valves
High chemical stability in the presence of refrigerants at high discharge temperatures
Low foaming tendency in reciprocating and rotary screw compressors
Excellent thermal shock breaking and lubricity

name: EDM Oil (Spark Erosion Fluid)
spec: Meets All Modern EDM Die-Sinking Standards
equivalent: MEETS ALL OTHER REPUTED BRAND SPECS
tagline: Ultra-pure hydrocarbon dielectric fluid for high-precision spark erosion die sinking.
description: Kembot EDM Series is an ultra-pure synthetic-grade dielectric fluid formulated with narrow boiling range hydrocarbons for electrical discharge machining (EDM).
applications: Roughing and high-precision finishing operations on all EDM die-sinking machines (Charmilles, Makino, Mitsubishi, Sodick).
Precision tool and mold manufacturing, aerospace components, and micro-machining.
usageGuide: Fill EDM dielectric tanks. Ensure continuous circulation through paper cartridge filters for swarf removal.
features: High dielectric strength with rapid spark deionization for faster cutting rates
Superior flushing ability washing carbon particles cleanly out of spark gaps
High flash point (> 100 °C) providing elevated operator and workshop fire safety
Extremely low aromatic content, odorless, non-toxic, and non-irritating
Zero electrode wear and mirror cavity surface finish

name: Auto Special Fluids & Treatments
spec: Meets All Reputed Automotive Special Specifications
equivalent: MEETS ALL OTHER REPUTED BRAND SPECS
tagline: Specialty automotive maintenance fluids, engine flushes, and performance enhancers.
description: Kembot Auto Special represents high-performance automotive specialty formulations including concentrated engine flushes, radiator coolants, injector cleaners, and transmission specialty fluids.
applications: Passenger cars, commercial utility vehicles, and heavy fleet maintenance.
Pre-oil change crankcase cleaning and engine sludge removal.
Specialty power steering and auxiliary automotive mechanisms.
usageGuide: Follow specific product instructions (e.g., add engine flush before oil drain and idle for 10 minutes).
features: Restores engine cleanliness and optimizes compression
Dissolves stubborn carbon deposits, gums, and varnish
Protects internal seals and rubber gaskets against degradation
Maintains optimal vehicle responsiveness and fuel efficiency

name: Multi Grade Engine Oil (Milby)
equivalent: CRB PLUS 20/W/40, CASTROL GTX 20/W/50
tagline: All-weather multigrade diesel and gasoline engine oil for reliable commercial transport.
description: Kembot Milby is a premium multigrade crankcase lubricant engineered for heavy-duty diesel engines operating under severe stop-and-go and highway hauling conditions.
applications: Commercial trucks, buses, light commercial vehicles (LCVs), and utility tractors.
Naturally aspirated and turbocharged diesel engines requiring 20W40 / 20W50 API CF-4.
Mixed fleet transport operations.
usageGuide: Recommended for oil drain intervals up to 18,000 – 25,000 km depending on engine OEM guidance and duty cycles.
features: Controls soot-induced oil thickening and prevents piston ring sticking
Excellent all-season viscosity retention with shear-stable polymers
High TBN reserve neutralizing corrosive combustion acids
Superior anti-wear protection for valve trains and cylinder liners
Low oil consumption and extended engine overhaul life

name: Premium Multi Grade Diesel Engine Oil (MIL-C)
brand: KEMBOT PREMIUM 15W/40 (CF4, CH4, CJ4, CK+ Series)
spec: API CK-4 / CJ-4 / CI-4 Plus / CH-4 / CF-4, ACEA E9/E7, MB 228.31, Volvo VDS-4.5
equivalent: DEUSOL SUPER / SERVO / MAGNATEC SERIES SERVO PRIDE / GTX EXTRA CF-4 SERIES
tagline: Advanced heavy-duty diesel engine oil for modern BS-VI / Euro VI fleets with DPF and SCR.
description: Kembot Premium Diesel Engine Oil is a top-tier heavy-duty lubricant formulated with synthetic blend base oils and Low-SAPS additive technology to protect modern emission-controlled diesel engines.
applications: Modern high-speed, 4-stroke heavy-duty diesel engines equipped with EGR, DPF, and SCR emission systems.
Heavy commercial vehicles (Tata, Ashok Leyland, BharatBenz, Volvo, Scania, MAN).
Off-highway construction and mining equipment (CAT, Komatsu, JCB, Volvo).
usageGuide: Enables extended drain intervals up to 50,000+ km in heavy highway long-haul applications with regular oil condition monitoring.
features: Outstanding soot dispersancy preventing abrasive wear and filter plugging
Advanced Low-SAPS formulation protects Diesel Particulate Filters (DPF) from clogging
Unrivaled piston deposit control and ring-stick resistance under heavy loads
Superior shear stability maintaining high oil film strength under severe thermal stress
Promotes fuel economy and ensures effortless cold-weather engine starts

name: 4T / 4T Plus Motorcycle Oils
spec: JASO MA2 / API SN / SM / SL
equivalent: MAK 4T, SERVO 4T, ACTIVE 4T, IDEMITSU - 4T PLUS
tagline: High-performance 3-in-1 protection for motorcycle engine, clutch, and gearbox.
description: Kembot 4T Plus is a premium 4-stroke motorcycle engine oil engineered with Synthetic Boosters and Friction Modifiers to deliver high throttle response, clutch grip, and gear protection.
applications: Modern 4-stroke motorcycles, sports bikes, cruisers, and scooters (Hero, Honda, Bajaj, TVS, Yamaha, Royal Enfield, Suzuki, KTM).
Wet-clutch integrated engine-gearbox-clutch configurations.
usageGuide: Drain old oil completely and refill with recommended grade per motorcycle owner manual (10W30 for modern commuter bikes, 20W50 for cruisers / Royal Enfield).
features: JASO MA2 certification ensures 100% clutch grip without clutch slippage
Smooth gear shifting and gearbox wear reduction
Keeps engine cool even in dense city stop-and-go traffic
High thermal resistance preventing oil degradation at high engine RPMs
Rapid acceleration and enhanced power output

name: Rust Preventive Oils (RPO Series)
equivalent: EQUIVALENT TO OTHER REPUTED BRANDS (Rustlick, Castrol Rustilo)
tagline: Fast-acting dewatering and dry/wet protective barrier oils for inter-operational and export storage.
description: Kembot RPO Series rust preventives are blended with active film-forming additives, moisture-displacing surfactants, and corrosion inhibitors dissolved in volatile hydrocarbon carriers.
applications: Protection of machined metal components, bearing rings, camshafts, fasteners, and sheet metal.
Export shipping protection and indoor/outdoor warehouse storage.
Dewatering of components after aqueous machining, grinding, or washing.
usageGuide: Apply by dipping, spraying, or brushing onto clean metal surfaces at ambient temperature. Allow solvent to flash off for 10–15 minutes.
features: Instant dewatering action displacing water drops from metal pores
Choice of Dry Film (DW 902) or Oily Protective Film (DW 901 / 904)
Exceptional salt spray and humidity cabinet rust protection (up to 12 - 24 months)
Easily removable with mild solvents or standard industrial wash cleaners
Fingerprint neutralization capability on freshly handled precision tools

name: Front Fork Oils (Suspension Fluid)
spec: Premium Motorcycle Fork & Shock Absorber Standards
equivalent: EQUIVALENT TO OTHER REPUTED BRANDS (Motul, Servo Fork Oil)
tagline: High-damping hydraulic suspension fluid for smooth road handling and zero foaming.
description: Kembot Fork Oil is a high viscosity index hydraulic fluid formulated specifically for motorcycle telescopic forks and shock absorbers.
applications: Front telescopic suspension forks and rear shock absorbers on all two-wheelers.
Street bikes, off-road motocross motorcycles, and heavy cruisers.
usageGuide: Refill fork legs according to motorcycle manufacturer oil volume specifications (cc / mm height).
features: Consistent damping performance across a wide operating temperature spectrum
Zero foaming and rapid air release preventing harsh suspension rebound
Protects internal seals against hardening, shrinking, and leaking
Superior anti-wear protection for fork slider bushings and damper rods

name: Industrial & Automotive Greases
brand: AP3, EP2, COPPER, ALVANIA, EP 0, EP00
equivalent: EQUIVALENT TO OTHER REPUTED BRANDS (Servo Grease, Mobilux, Shell Gadus)
tagline: Heavy-duty lithium, lithium complex, and specialty anti-seize greases.
description: Kembot Grease range includes Lithium All-Purpose (AP3), Extreme Pressure (EP2, EP0, EP00), High Temperature Lithium Complex, and Copper Anti-Seize compounds for severe friction and load conditions.
applications: Automotive wheel bearings, chassis lubrication, universal joints, and kingpins.
Industrial ball and roller bearings, centralized grease systems (EP 0, EP 00).
High temperature threaded connections, boiler studs, and kiln bearings (Copper Grease).
usageGuide: Apply with grease gun, mechanical pump, or centralized automatic greasing unit. Do not mix incompatible soap bases.
features: High mechanical stability resisting thinning and leakage under vibration
Superb water-washout resistance and corrosion protection
High drop point (> 190 °C for AP3/EP2, > 260 °C for Lithium Complex)
Extreme pressure load-carrying capacity with 4-Ball weld load > 250 kgf
Extended re-lubrication intervals reducing downtime
